whoItsFor: Developers with basic Python skills and a rough understanding of LLM APIs, such as AI developers, software engineers, students, and self-learners who want to build AI-native agents rather than just use low-code tools.
useCases: Learn agent fundamentals and implement classic paradigms like ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Reflection
Compare low-code agent platforms (Coze, Dify, n8n) with frameworks such as AutoGen, AgentScope, and LangGraph
Build end-to-end projects like a travel planning assistant, a deep research agent, and a simulated town
